# LaplandStore

> A curated directory of Lapland boutiques from Rovaniemi to Utsjoki: crafts, jewellery, reindeer antler, ceramics and Lapland delicacies. Some ship to you.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://laplandstore.fi/): the boutique directory itself: verified Lapland makers and shops with what they sell and where to find them.
- [Etusivu suomeksi](https://laplandstore.fi/fi/): sama kuratoitu putiikkihakemisto suomeksi.
- [Privacy Policy](https://laplandstore.fi/privacy/): how the site handles personal data.
- [Terms of Use](https://laplandstore.fi/terms/): terms for using the directory.
- [Cookie Policy](https://laplandstore.fi/cookie-policy/): what cookies the site uses.

## Languages

English (default, no prefix), Finnish (/fi/), Swedish (/sv/), German (/de/), Spanish (/es/), French (/fr/), Italian (/it/), Dutch (/nl/), Japanese (/ja/), Korean (/kr/), Brazilian Portuguese (/br/), Chinese (/cn/).
